uDemoRelativeWorldPosition = (objectWorld - cameraWorld), CPU double precision; uDemoViewRotationMatrix = view matrix WITHOUT translation

Same Rebase + RTE two-layer scheme, documented as 同一种思想的两个层面 (cad-rendering-porting-notes.md:4, opencadstudio-architecture-reference.md:146). Host implementation: lib/coordinate/WorldRebase.h, chunkSize 1e4, chunk-anchored rebase origin, per-object uModelRelativePosition.

Not referenced by name in docs, but it is the ONLY desktop-OpenGL CAD renderer here: draw-call/state reduction, Hi-Z occlusion culling, and double-precision CAD matrix splitting (README.md:197) all map onto the host's problems.

Not referenced in docs. Candidate replacement/alternative for the host's GPU ID-buffer picking: CPU ray-traced exact picking + occlusion against tessellated geometry. Caveat: this vendored copy is stripped of kernels/traverse and kernels/geom and has not been shown to build.

Not referenced in docs. Candidate for dense imported meshes: simplify + buildMeshlets, and optimizeVertexCache/Fetch for OpenGL draw cost. Must be restricted to tessellated display meshes, never parametric feature geometry.
mcut/source/shewchuk.c bundles the same public-domain predicates. Linking both clashes on orient2d/insphere. MCUT could consume the standalone one instead.
qaws covers arc-length reparameterization + constant-speed traversal with S-curve profiles, 11 easing modes and wrap modes - a superset of simpline's entire niche.
Both do tolerance-based curve flattening. arcs uses explicitly-cited Ramer-Douglas-Peucker plus chord-tolerance; qaws does curvature-weighted adaptive sampling.

Four overlapping NURBS/curve libraries total (qaws, LNLib, gbs, CAD-main's single Bernstein function). qaws additionally has a GLSL/HLSL/Halide backend; LNLib has more complete The-NURBS-Book coverage; gbs adds a B-rep arena.
Both are LGPL LGPL-2.1 vs LGPL-3.0 and both implement full NURBS Book curve+surface+offset+loft. gbs additionally ships a native B-rep arena and half-edge meshing.
Curvature/offset/loft/intersection overlap. gbs has documented algorithms and a licence; qaws has no licence and no build system.

Both implement polyhedral Boolean via DCEL arrangement + In/On/Out face-group classification. CZY3DKernel is C++/OCCT-bound; cadcore is Rust/OCCT-free and positioned as OCCT's replacement. Reading them side by side is the cheapest way to decide whether the host adopts OCCT or writes its own.
Both carry a DCEL implementation (KrisLibrary geometry/DCEL.h vs CZY3DKernel CAD/Boolean/Topo.hxx).
Both carry half-edge meshing (KrisLibrary TriMeshTopology/MarchingCubes vs gbs-mesh/halfedgemesh.h).
Both carry vendored KD-tree and R-tree (UTILS/KDtree,Rtree vs gbs' own spatial structures).
Spatial indexing triplicated across the tree: LNLib Octree/Voronoi, KrisLibrary KDTree/BallTree, CZY3DKernel KDtree/Rtree. Pick one, do not vendor all three.
Spatial indexing overlap (KDTree/BallTree vs KDtree/Rtree).

tiny_gltf.h expects stb_image/stb_image_write for embedded textures, and both live in this same external/ tree - but tinygltf's CMakeLists has no path to stb. Escape hatches: TINYGLTF_NO_STB_IMAGE / TINYGLTF_NO_STB_IMAGE_WRITE. Neither ships a README.

meshopt_buildMeshlets (cone-weighted clusters + computeMeshletBounds) is the producer side of the problem Embree's BVH4/BVH8 node packing solves on the consumer side. Plausible hand-off: decimate + cluster, then pack into an Embree scene.
OpenCTM (2009, dormant) is superseded for a modern pipeline by glTF + Draco + meshopt; glTF 2.0 now carries an EXT_meshopt_compression path and meshoptimizer is already vendored here.

Both solve the same CAD problem - draw-call and state reduction for many-part assemblies - by different means: VSG's portable RenderGraph compile traversal vs gl_cadscene's UBO sub-range binding + NVIDIA token replay + indexed MDI. Also both do occlusion culling (VSG CullGroup/CullNode vs gl_cadscene Hi-Z + raster + temporal bits); only gl_cadscene documents the algorithm in enough detail to reimplement.

The three rendering stacks in this tree are mutually exclusive: VSG = Vulkan-only, OpenCADStudio = wgpu (its 'gl' path is GLES translation, not desktop GL), gl_cadscene = real desktop OpenGL. The host is OpenGL, so only gl_cadscene's code ports.

VSG keeps a portable Object/Visitor/Switch/Bin/LOD hierarchy; gl_cadscene deliberately REPLACES that with a data-oriented flat NodeTree + parallel arrays for speed. Worth studying both sides of this tension for the host's acgs layer.

Three transferable ideas, all GPL-2 so reimplementation-not-copying only: reversed-Z depth buffer for large-map depth precision (the host instead uses log-depth / DoubleSingle), lightmap atlas merging, and the Zone allocator's out-of-memory-free policy. None are CAD-relevant beyond depth precision.

Opposite persistence bet: Neo4j graph store + FastAPI service tier vs the host's SQLite + WAL + acdb transactions + bounded undo stack. Useful only as a contrast case for document-model versioning (project -> model -> version).
Both decompose a CAD scene with an ECS (entt vs specs/shred) and implement picking as a system. CAD-main adds a command-pattern group transform; arcs adds coordinate-space typing via euclid.

Both are MIT-licensed B-rep-from-meshes frameworks of very different shape: OpenGeode is a module framework with a satellite ecosystem and Python bindings; cadcore is a single exact-analytic kernel with a slotmap arena and a STEP writer. cadcore additionally documents AP214 manifold invariants; OpenGeode additionally covers geoscience objects.

open_risks.title: OCCT 路线分叉未决
open_risks.detail: CZY3DKernel 绑定 OCCT>=7.2；cadcore 明确把自己定位为 OCCT 替代品但只覆盖 sweep/半空间裁剪。宿主自建内核要不要引 OCCT，读这两个是最便宜的方式。

open_risks.title: 资产管线缺口
open_risks.detail: stb_image 不支持 DDS，tinygltf 也没有 DDS 路径。若资产管线要出 DirectX 表面格式需另找方案。tinygltf 的 CMake 也不知道同目录下 stb 在哪。

open_risks.title: 24 个项目里只有 1 个真的被编译
open_risks.detail: CMakeLists.txt 只编译 external/predicates。其余 23 个处于 vendored-but-unwired 状态：既不进构建，也没有注释说明引入原因。建议要么接线要么删减，否则 external/ 会持续膨胀成无人维护的参考堆。
